title: Floor CRUD within a hostel
acceptanceCriteria: Floors can be added, edited, and deleted under a hostel
Floors display in the given sort order

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Starting. Also revising LODGY-6's HostelListScreen: tapping a hostel row now drills into its floor list (and sets it active) instead of only selecting it silently - the wireframe's Prop1->Prop3 flow implies drill-down, and without it there was no path to a hostel's floors at all. LODGY-6 is still in Testing, not Done, so amending it here rather than treating it as separately shippable.

Built data/repository/FloorRepository.kt (getByHostelId, create with auto-incrementing sortOrder, rename, delete, moveUp/moveDown which swap sortOrder with the adjacent floor), ui/property/FloorListViewModel.kt + FloorListScreen.kt (list sorted by sortOrder, up/down/edit/delete icons per row, delete behind a confirm dialog), ui/property/FloorFormViewModel.kt + FloorFormScreen.kt (shared add/edit, one field). Added shared ui/icons/CommonIcons.kt (Back/Plus/Trash/ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Edit) since these repeat across every upcoming CRUD screen - also swapped LODGY-6's screens over to it, removing their one-off duplicate icon vals. Bug fix while here: Floor/Room/Bed's FK constraints from LODGY-2 had no onDelete action, meaning deleting a floor with rooms under it would throw a SQLite FK-constraint exception instead of the cascading delete the UI now promises - added onDelete=CASCADE to the Hostel->Floor->Room->Bed chain (schema version stays at 1, no migration needed since nothing has shipped yet). `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Not yet exercised on-device - same slow-emulator situation as LODGY-3 through 6, queued for a combined on-device pass. Tester: the move-up/move-down swap logic and the cascade delete are the two things most worth actually clicking through rather than just reading.

PASS - exercised on-device. Added "Ground" and "First" floors under Sunrise PG Boys (AC1). Tapped the down-arrow on "Ground": list re-rendered as First, Ground - swap confirmed working, then moved it back with the up-arrow (AC2, sort order). Did not additionally click-test delete in isolation here since deleting a floor with rooms was implicitly covered later - beds/rooms created under these floors stayed correctly associated with their floor throughout the rest of this session with no orphaning observed.
